response.sql: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT `ANA Pattern` AS pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg FROM Examination GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) AS mean_avg FROM group_averages), kept AS (SELECT g.pattern, g.avg_acl_igg, g.avg_acl_igg - o.mean_avg AS above_overall_mean FROM group_averages AS g CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS o WHERE g.avg_acl_igg > o.mean_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) AS mean_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.pattern, k.avg_acl_igg, k.above_overall_mean, ABS(k.avg_acl_igg - m.mean_avg) AS distance_from_kept_mean FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN kept_mean AS m;
